strategies.english_title: Different Expressions of the Same Object
strategies.strategy_name_en: Different Expressions of the Same Object
strategies.summary_en: Represent the same mathematical object in two different ways and compare the resulting formulas. This often reveals a new identity, inequality, or structural relation.
strategies.applicability: Use this when an object admits multiple natural descriptions, such as algebraic, analytic, or combinatorial representations.
strategies.callout_body: 用两种不同的途径表示同一个对象，从而导出新的关系。
